_about: Hero vehicle parameters. Change these to swap in a different car - no code edit. hue_ranges are HSV [lo,hi] pairs (hue wraps red); open_kernel removes specks; close_kernel joins the body's red halves across the windscreen; min_area rejects smaller red things. Re-record the front/rear template afterwards: capture_vehicle_profile.py --record --label right|left then --finalize.
